title: Edit concepts in the wiki: create, rename, aliases, links, merge and undo
description: Ryan 2026-11-03: in the newsroom wiki, create and edit concepts, link synonyms and mark things related, by hand. Create; edit name, description and aliases on any concept, protected from runs by the get-or-create rule; typed links with a relationship and a note (a fact starts as a typed link plus a note); merge into one node with the losing node retired as an alias_of pointer, moved links, and undo. Rule of thumb: same thing is one node with aliases; two nodes found to be the same get merged; related or unsure stays two nodes with a noted link. Requires the knowledge run ticket.
